column1: # Graded relevance judgements for the Ayira matching evaluation.
#   3    ideal      — this is squarely the worker's job
#   2    good       — they could do it well
#   1    marginal   — plausible but a stretch; a weak result
#   0    irrelevant — omitted from this file; any pair not listed is graded 0
# Judgements are author-assigned as part of corpus design
# annotated. A second annotator and an inter-annotator agreement score are
# noted as future work in the evaluation write-up.
# Hard cases are included deliberately — pairs where surface wording pulls one
# way and the correct grade goes the other. They are marked in the notes column
# and are the ones worth watching when a change moves the metrics.
